blocks.p: The *Equipment* tab of the *Character* window shows what your character wears and holds. It has two views, a list and a doll, and the two buttons at the top right of the tab switch between them.
In the doll each place an item can be worn has a slot of its own, set out round a figure of the character. The slots are grouped as in Table 22-1.

table.label: Table 22-1
table.title: The slots of the doll
head: Area
Slots
rows: *Head*, *Eyes*, *Neck*, *Arms*, *Torso*, *Outer* and *Hands*, with small slots from *Ears* and *Nose* down to *Rings right*.
*Back* and the slots beside it (*Satchel*, *Air tank*, *Tail*), then *Belt*, *Legs* and *Feet*, with small slots from *Knees* down to *Ankles*.
*Main* and *Off* for the hands, then the numbered belt slots, *Belt 1* to *Belt 5*.
*Loadouts*, then a grade for what you wear.

blocks.note: A worn item shows in its slot with a bar under it for its condition. An empty slot is drawn with a dashed outline. A number on a slot is how many items are worn in it.

blocks.p: To take off an item, drag it to a bag or to the ground.
